messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I’m having issues with my mobile data. My internet often stops working or it’s very slow. I really want excellent internet speed on my phone. I don’t have access to WiFi, so I need to fix my mobile data as soon as possible. Can you help me get an excellent internet connection?

I can help you with your mobile data issue. To get started, I’ll need to verify your account. Could you please provide either your phone number, customer ID, or your full name and date of birth? This will help me identify your account and assist you further.
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any more details!

Thank you for providing your details. I’ve found your account and see that you have multiple lines. Could you please confirm which phone number (or line) is experiencing the mobile data issues? Is it the same number you provided (555-123-2002), or another one on your account?
Yes, the number 555-123-2002—the one I provided—is the line that’s having the mobile data issues.

{"plan_id": "P1002", "name": "Premium Plan", "data_limit_gb": 15.0, "price_per_month": 65.0, "data_refueling_price_per_gb": 2.0}
{"line_id": "L1002", "data_used_gb": "15.1", "data_limit_gb": "15.0", "data_refueling_gb": "0.0", "cycle_end_date": "2025-02-28"}

Your current plan has a 15GB monthly data limit, and you’ve already used 15.1GB this cycle. That’s why your mobile data is slow or not working—your plan’s data limit has been exceeded.

You have two options to restore excellent internet speed:
1. Refuel your data (add up to 2GB for $2.00 per GB).
2. Change to a plan with a higher data limit.

Would you like to refuel your data now, or are you interested in exploring plans with more data? If you want to refuel, please let me know how many GB (up to 2GB) you’d like to add.
I don’t want to change my plan, but I’m okay with refueling data if that will get me excellent internet speed. Please add 2GB to my plan. Let me know once it’s done!
{"message": "Successfully added 2 GB of data for line L1002 for $4.00", "new_data_refueling_gb": "2.0", "charge": "4.0"}

2GB of data has been successfully added to your plan for $4.00. You should now have restored mobile data access and can enjoy excellent internet speed again.

If you don’t see an improvement right away, please try restarting your phone. Let me know if you need any further assistance!
Thank you! Before I restart my phone, can we check if my internet speed is actually excellent now? I want to be sure the speed is back to excellent before doing anything else.

To check your current internet speed, please run a speed test on your phone. Once you have the results, let me know what it says about your connection quality (e.g., excellent, good, fair, poor, or no connection). This will help us confirm if your speed is excellent or if further troubleshooting is needed.
(guides the customer through a device action)
Speed test failed: No Connection.
I ran a speed test, but it failed and says “No Connection.” My mobile data still isn’t working. What should I do next?

Thank you for letting me know. Since your data refuel was successful but you still have no connection, let’s troubleshoot further. 

First, let’s check your phone’s status bar for any indicators that might explain the issue (such as Airplane Mode, no signal, or data disabled). Please check your phone’s status bar and let me know if you see any of the following:
- Airplane Mode icon
- No signal or very low signal bars
- “Data Disabled” or similar message

If you’re not sure, you can describe what icons or messages you see at the top of your screen. This will help us identify the next step.
(guides the customer through a device action)
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔋 80%
Looking at my status bar, I see excellent signal strength and 5G, but there is also a “Data Disabled” icon showing. What should I do to fix this?

The “Data Disabled” icon means your mobile data is currently turned off on your phone, which is why you have no internet connection.

To fix this, please go to your phone’s settings and turn mobile data ON. Once you’ve enabled mobile data, try running the speed test again and let me know if your internet connection is restored and if the speed is excellent.
(guides the customer through a device action)

Mobile Data is now ON.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
(guides the customer through a device action)
Speed Test Result: 275.00 Mbps (Excellent). Connection is very fast.

I turned my mobile data back on and ran the speed test again. The result shows 275 Mbps and says the connection is excellent—very fast. It looks like everything is working perfectly now! Thank you for your help.

That’s great to hear! Your internet speed is now excellent, and your mobile data is working perfectly.

If you have any more questions or need further assistance in the future, feel free to reach out. Have a wonderful day!
Thank you! I really appreciate your help getting my internet speed back to excellent. Everything’s working perfectly now. Have a great day! ###STOP###
Post-call QA note: issue confirmed resolved during the call; environment checks passed.
